name: Omm
rootCause: On January 21, 2023, the Omm lending protocol on ICON was exploited for roughly $1.9M due to a vulnerability in its Redeem function, allowing an attacker to systematically drain user collateral by bypassing accounting invariants. The core Redeem function failed to properly check withdrawal legitimacy and accounting invariants, permitting redemptions that exceeded deposited value and allowed unauthorized draining of protocol collateral.
